result.summary: The 2019 Credo reframes employee and community commitments: adds 'inclusive work environment', 'respect their diversity', 'sense of security, fulfillment and purpose', 'support the health and well-being of our employees', and 'help people be healthier'; adds 'provide value' and 'investments made for the future'; changes 'customers' to 'patients' first; drops the intro paragraph on Robert Wood Johnson and the 'put the needs... first' framing.
